scope: Two separate Worker roles. A wallet-derived canonical key, fresh nonce commitments, and silent-OT GMW correlations precede readiness. Nonce conversion and decomposition also use GMW. Each fixed chunk uses real full-block IKNP. Eight candidates form one consuming reservation. All candidates run in three online batches. No R2 table read occurs. Direct uniform nonce sampling replaces the FIPS hedged nonce procedure.
limits: Yao loads its first fresh table group before admission. GMW prepares fresh private correlations and retains packed shares. Readiness includes this work. Online time includes input delivery, dependent exchanges, later Yao table reads, retries, verification, and completion. Cold or empty pools have no five-second success claim.

Native fixture generation derives owner roots from known disposable wallet seeds. Workers receive only their root shares and execute root-to-canonical-key derivation. Production custody envelopes, admission, durable activation, and pool restart are not implemented.
Cf colo fields describe request metadata. They do not independently establish each physical compute or storage placement.
These samples establish observed latency only. They are not a production percentile or successful-signature deadline guarantee.
